queries.query: SELECT status,aggregate_type,event_type,COUNT(*)::int AS n,MIN(created_at) AS oldest,MAX(created_at) AS newest,SUM(CASE WHEN attempts>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS attempted FROM cko_orch.outbox_events GROUP BY status,aggregate_type,event_type ORDER BY status,aggregate_type,event_type
SELECT state,domain,affected_theme,COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM calculadoras_de_enfermagem.reconciliation_holds GROUP BY state,domain,affected_theme ORDER BY state,domain,affected_theme
SELECT theme,match_status,verified,COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM calculadoras_de_enfermagem.source_lineage GROUP BY theme,match_status,verified ORDER BY theme,match_status,verified
